 CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE EDITIONABLE VIEW "IMBANK_IBPS5"."RW_CLOS_CA_MAIN" ("WORKITEM_NAME", "PROPOSAL_NO", "APPLICATION_DATE", "BRANCH", "BUSSINESS_SEGMENT", "BORROWER_NAME", "CUSTOMER_CIF", "GROUP_NAME", "GROUP_CIF", "SUB_SUB_INDUSTRY_TYPE", "SUB_INDUSTRY_TYPE", "CLASSIFICATION", "DATE_OF_BIRTH", "RELATIONSHIP_DATE", "BORROWING_SINCE", "RELATIONSHIP_MANAGER", "LAST_REVIEW_STEP", "NEXT_REVIEW_STEP", "EXTENSION_SOUGHT", "CUMULATIVE_EXTENSION", "CURRENT_ACCOUNT_STRATEGY", "PROPOSED_ACCOUNT_STRATEGY", "APPROVING_AUTHORITY", "RISK_RATING", "RISK_RATING_ENV_SOCIAL", "SUMMARY_OF_PURPOSAL", "OVERVIEW_REMARKS_CLOB", "COMMENTS_CLOB", "OVERVIEW_BORROWER_BUSINESS", "MGMNT_TP_REMARKS", "CONCESSION_CLOB", "JUSTIFICATION", "BUSSINESS_ACTIVITY", "INDUSTRY_REVIEW", "TECHNOLOGY_USAGE", "RECENT_DEVELOP", "SALES_PROFITABITY", "INVENTORY", "DEBT_COMMENTS", "CRED_COMMENTS", "OTHER_CURRENT_ASSETS", "OVERDRAFT", "DIRECTORS_ACCOUNTS", "OTHER_PAYABLES", "OTHER_CURRENT_ASSETS_LIABILTY", "ACCOUNT_CONDUCT_REMARKS", "LOAN_REPAYMENT_REMARKS", "NON_FUNDED_REMARKS", "CUSTOMER_PROFIT_REMARKS", "GROUP_PROFIT_REMARKS", "SHARE_COMMENTS_CLOB", "TANGIBLE_REMARKS", "INTANGIBLE_REMARKS", "REMARKS_POLICY", "FINANCIAL_COV_REMARKS", "NON_FINANCIAL_COV_REMARKS", "REPAYMENTS_INCOME_REMARKS", "REPAYMENTS_RATE_REMARKS", "REPAYMENTS_BANK_REMARKS", "GROUP_AGGREGATE_EXPOSURE", "GROUP_AGGREGATE_PRESENT", "GROUP_AGGREGATE_OUTSTANDING", "GROUP_AGGREGATE_INCREASE", "IM_MEMBER_TOTAL_PROPOSED", "IM_MEMBER_TOTAL_INC_DEC", "DILIGENCE_CHECKLIST", "NEMA_EIA_REPORT", "COMMENTS_ES", "ASSESSMENT_FAC_COMMENTS", "COLLATERAL_REMARKS", "TANGIBLE_REMARKS1", "INTANGIBLE_REMARKS1", "ASSESMENT_OF_FACILIY_REMARKS", "NEW_EXIST_FACILTY_REMARKS_CLOB", "SWOT_STRENGTH_CLOB", "SWOT_WEAKNESS_CLOB", "SWOT_OPP_CLOB", "SWOT_THREAT_CLOB", "SECURITYCVROMV", "SECURITYCVRFSV", "TOTAL_CHARGE", "FSV", "OMV", "EAUDITCOMMENTS", "IAUDITCOMMENTS", "WORKING_CAPITAL", "FINANACIAL_NET_ASSETS", "FINANCIAL_NET_GROWTH", "FINANCIAL_CASH_FLOW", "CORE_CAPITAL_AMOUNT", "IM_MEMBER_TOTAL_LIMIT", "IM_MEMBER_TOTAL_OUTSTANDING", "TOTAL_SHARSHOLDINGS", "GROUP_PRESENT_CONC_LIMIT", "GROUP_EXPOSRE_CONC_LIMIT", "TOTAL_NONFUNDED", "TOTAL_FUNDED", "COMPLIANCE_COMMENTS", "REPAYMENT_ST_COMMENTS", "CUSTOMER_NAME", "AUDITOR", "CURRENCY_DENOMINATION", "AUDITOR_OPINION", "COLLATERAL_COMMENTS", "PREVIOUS_COVENANTS", "PROPOSED_COVENANTS", "FACILITY_COMMENTS_CLOB", "FIRST_SOURCE_INDEX", "SECOND_SOURCE_INDEX", "THIRD_SOURCE_INDEX", "FOURTH_SOURCE_INDEX", "PREPARED_BY_USERNAME", "PREPARED_BY_DESIGNATION", "PREPARED_BY_ENTRY_DATE_TIME", "RECOMMENDED_BY_USERNAME", "RECOMMENDED_BY_DESIGNATION", "RECOMMENDED_BY_ENTRY_DATE_TIME", "APPROVED_BY_USERNAME", "APPROVED_BY_DESIGNATION", "APPROVED_BY_ENTRY_DATE_TIME", "PHONE", "EMAIL", "CONTACT_PERSON", "PO_BOX", "PHYSICAL_ADDRESS", "PUBLICLY_LISTED", "POLITICALLY_EXPOSED", "MARKET_CAPITALISATION", "PREVIOUS_RISK_RATING", "CREDIT_REQUEST", "IS_IM_BANK_PARTY_INSIDER") DEFAULT COLLATION "USING_NLS_COMP"  AS 
  (SELECT (workitem_name),
           proposal_no,
           application_date,
           branch,
           bussiness_segment,
           borrower_name,
           customer_cif,
           group_name,
           group_cif,
           sub_sub_industry_type,
           sub_industry_type,
           classification,
           date_of_birth,
           relationship_date,
           borrowing_since,
           relationship_manager,
           last_review_step,
           next_review_step,
		   extension_sought,
		   cumulative_extension,
           current_account_strategy,
           proposed_account_strategy,
           approving_authority,
           risk_rating,
           risk_rating_env_social,
           summary_of_purposal,
           overview_remarks_clob,
           comments_clob,
           overview_borrower_business,
           Mgmnt_Tp_Remarks,
           concession_clob,
           justification,
           bussiness_activity,
           industry_review,
           technology_usage,
           recent_develop,
           sales_profitabity,
           inventory,
           debt_comments,
           cred_comments,
           other_current_assets,
           overdraft,
           directors_accounts,
           other_payables,
           other_current_assets_liabilty,
           account_conduct_remarks,
           loan_repayment_remarks,
           non_funded_remarks,
           Customer_Profit_Remarks,
           Group_Profit_Remarks,
           Share_Comments_Clob,
           Tangible_Remarks,
           Intangible_Remarks,
           Remarks_Policy,
           Financial_Cov_Remarks,
           Non_Financial_Cov_Remarks,
           repayments_income_remarks,
           repayments_rate_remarks,
           repayments_bank_remarks,
           
           DECODE (NVL (group_aggregate_exposure, 0), 0, '-', TO_CHAR (group_aggregate_exposure / 1000, '999,999,999,999,990'))
			AS group_aggregate_exposure,
           DECODE (NVL (group_aggregate_present, 0), 0, '-', TO_CHAR (group_aggregate_present / 1000, '999,999,999,999,990'))
           AS GROUP_AGGREGATE_PRESENT,
           DECODE (NVL (group_aggregate_outstanding, 0), 0, '-', TO_CHAR (group_aggregate_outstanding / 1000, '999,999,999,999,990'))
           AS group_aggregate_outstanding,
		   DECODE (NVL (group_aggregate_increase, 0), 0, '-', TO_CHAR (group_aggregate_increase / 1000, '999,999,999,999,990'))
           AS group_aggregate_increase,
		   DECODE (NVL (im_member_total_proposed, 0), 0, '-', TO_CHAR (im_member_total_proposed / 1000, '999,999,999,999,990'))
           AS im_member_total_proposed,
           im_member_total_inc_dec,
           diligence_checklist,
           nema_eia_report,
           comments_es,
           assessment_fac_comments,
           collateral_remarks,
           tangible_remarks1,
           intangible_remarks1,
           assesment_of_faciliy_remarks,
           new_exist_facilty_remarks_clob,
           swot_strength_clob,
           swot_weakness_clob,
           swot_opp_clob,
           swot_threat_clob,
           SecurityCvrOMV,
           SecurityCvrFSV,
           Total_Charge,
           FSV,
           OMV,
           eauditcomments,
           iauditcomments,
           working_capital,
           finanacial_net_assets,
           financial_net_growth,
           financial_cash_flow,
           core_capital_amount,
           --TO_CHAR (aggergate_conc_limit / 1000, '999,999,999,999,990')
           --AS aggergate_conc_limit,
           DECODE (
              NVL (group_aggregate_present, 0)
              + NVL (im_member_total_limit, 0),
              0, '-',
              TO_CHAR ((NVL(group_aggregate_present,0) + NVL(im_member_total_limit,0)) / 1000, '999,999,999,999,990'))
              AS im_member_total_limit,
           DECODE (
              NVL(group_aggregate_outstanding, 0)
              + NVL (im_member_total_outstanding, 0),
              0, '-',
              TO_CHAR ((NVL(group_aggregate_outstanding,0) + NVL(im_member_total_outstanding,0)) / 1000, '999,999,999,999,990'))
              AS im_member_total_outstanding,
           total_sharsholdings,
           ROUND ( (group_aggregate_present / core_capital_amount) * 100, 2)
              AS group_present_conc_limit,
           ROUND ( (group_aggregate_exposure / core_capital_amount) * 100, 2)
              AS group_exposre_conc_limit,
           total_nonfunded,
           total_funded,
           compliance_comments,
           REPAYMENT_ST_COMMENTS,
           customer_name,
           auditor,
           currency_denomination,
           auditor_opinion,
           COLLATERAL_COMMENTS,
           PREVIOUS_COVENANTS,
           PROPOSED_COVENANTS,
		   facility_Comments_Clob,
		   FIRST_SOURCE_INDEX,
   SECOND_SOURCE_INDEX,
   THIRD_SOURCE_INDEX,
   FOURTH_SOURCE_INDEX,
		   PREPARED_BY_USERNAME,
           PREPARED_BY_DESIGNATION,
           PREPARED_BY_ENTRY_DATE_TIME,
           RECOMMENDED_BY_USERNAME,
		   RECOMMENDED_BY_DESIGNATION,
		   RECOMMENDED_BY_ENTRY_DATE_TIME,
		   APPROVED_BY_USERNAME,
		   APPROVED_BY_DESIGNATION,
		   APPROVED_BY_ENTRY_DATE_TIME,
		   PHONE,
		   EMAIL,
		   CONTACT_PERSON,
		   PO_BOX,
		   PHYSICAL_ADDRESS,
		   PUBLICLY_LISTED,
		   POLITICALLY_EXPOSED,
		   MARKET_CAPITALISATION,
		   PREVIOUS_RISK_RATING,
		   CREDIT_REQUEST,
		   IS_IM_BANK_PARTY_INSIDER

      FROM (SELECT (customer.workitem_name) AS workitem_name,
                   (   customer.workitem_name
                    || '_'
                    || EXTRACT (YEAR FROM customer.application_iniation_date))
                      AS proposal_no,
                   TO_CHAR (customer.application_iniation_date, 'dd/MM/yyyy')
                      AS application_date,
                   customer.branch_name AS branch,
                   customer.business_segment AS bussiness_segment,
                   customer.borrower_name AS borrower_name,
                   customer.cif_id AS customer_cif,
                   customer.group_name AS group_name,
                   customer.group_cif_id AS group_cif,
                   customer.sub_sub_industry_type AS sub_sub_industry_type,
                   customer.industry_sub_type AS sub_industry_type,
                   customer.current_asset_classification AS classification,
                   TO_CHAR (customer.date_of_incorporation, 'dd/MM/yyyy')
                      AS date_of_birth,
                   TO_CHAR (customer.relationship_date, 'dd/MM/yyyy')
                      AS relationship_date,
                   TO_CHAR (customer.borrowing_since, 'dd/MM/yyyy')
                      AS borrowing_since,
                   customer.RELATIONSHIP_MANAGER AS relationship_manager,
                   TO_CHAR (customer.last_review_date, 'dd/MM/yyyy')
                      AS last_review_step,
                   TO_CHAR (customer.next_review_date, 'dd/MM/yyyy')
                      AS next_review_step,
					customer.extension_sought AS extension_sought,
					customer.cumulative_extension AS cumulative_extension,
                   decision.current_account_strategy
                      AS current_account_strategy,
                   decision.current_proposal_strategy
                      AS proposed_account_strategy,
                   ext.approving_authority AS approving_authority,
                   decision.current_risk_rating AS risk_rating,
                   env.risk_rating AS risk_rating_env_social,

                   (SELECT VALUE
                      FROM RW_CLOS_SPREADS_OUTPUT
                     WHERE     workitem_name = customer.workitem_name
                           AND identification_no = customer.identification_no
                           AND cell = 'B1')
                      AS customer_name,
                   (SELECT VALUE
                      FROM RW_CLOS_SPREADS_OUTPUT
                     WHERE     workitem_name = customer.workitem_name
                           AND identification_no = customer.identification_no
                           AND cell = 'B3')
                      AS auditor,
                   (SELECT VALUE
                      FROM RW_CLOS_SPREADS_OUTPUT
                     WHERE     workitem_name = customer.workitem_name
                           AND identification_no = customer.identification_no
                           AND cell = 'E1')
                      AS currency_denomination,
                   (SELECT VALUE
                      FROM RW_CLOS_SPREADS_OUTPUT
                     WHERE     workitem_name = customer.workitem_name
                           AND identification_no = customer.identification_no
                           AND cell = 'E2')
                      AS auditor_opinion,
                   cdata.collateral_comments AS COLLATERAL_COMMENTS,
                   c.FINANCIAL_COVENANTS_REMARKS AS PREVIOUS_COVENANTS,
                   c.NON_FINANCIAL_COVENANTS_REMARKS AS PROPOSED_COVENANTS,
                   REPLACE (decision.summary_proposal_index,
                            CHR (10),
                            '<br/>')
                      AS summary_of_purposal,
                   (REPLACE (
                       REGEXP_REPLACE (
                          REPLACE (REPLACE (client.overview, ' ', ' '),
                                   '&' || 'nbsp;',
                                   ''),
                          ' {2,}',
                          ''),
                       '’',
                       '''')
                    || ' '
                    || REPLACE (
                          REGEXP_REPLACE (
                             REPLACE (
                                REPLACE (client_details.business_activity,
                                         ' ',
                                         ' '),
                                '&' || 'nbsp;',
                                ''),
                             ' {2,}',
                             ''),
                          '’',
                          ''''))
                      AS overview_remarks_clob,
                   client.comments AS comments_clob,
                   client.OVERVIEW_DOC_INDEX AS overview_borrower_business,
                   client.COMMENTS_DOC_INDEX AS Mgmnt_Tp_Remarks,
                   concsumm.actual_pricing_index AS concession_clob,
                   concsumm.pricing_justification AS justification,
                   client_details.business_activity AS bussiness_activity,
                   (   client_details.industry_review
                    || '<br/>'
                    || client_details.technology_usage
                    || '<br/>'
                    || client_details.recent_development)
                      AS industry_review,
                   client_details.technology_usage AS technology_usage,
                   client_details.recent_development AS recent_develop,
                   REPLACE (sales.sales_profit, CHR (10), '<br/>')
                      AS sales_profitabity,
                   c.trade_inventory AS inventory,
                   c.trade_comments AS debt_comments,
                   c.liability_comments AS cred_comments,
                   c.trade_other AS other_current_assets,
                   c.liability_overdraft AS overdraft,
                   c.director_account AS directors_accounts,
                   c.other_payable AS other_payables,
                   c.other_current_asset AS other_current_assets_liabilty,
                   c.actcdt_oprtngact_comment AS account_conduct_remarks,
                   c.actcdt_trmfaclty_comments AS loan_repayment_remarks,
                   c.actcdt_nfundfclty_comments AS non_funded_remarks,
                   c.CUST_PROFIT_JUST AS Customer_Profit_Remarks,
                   c.GROUP_PROFIT_JUST AS Group_Profit_Remarks,
                   c.SHARE_COMMENTS_INDEX AS Share_Comments_Clob,
                   c.TANGIBLE_REMARKS_INDEX AS Tangible_Remarks,
                   c.INTANGIBLE_REMARKS_INDEX AS Intangible_Remarks,
                   c.POLICY_EXCEPTION_COMMENTS AS Remarks_Policy,
                   c.FINANCIAL_COVENANTS_REMARKS AS Financial_Cov_Remarks,
                   c.NON_FINANCIAL_COVENANTS_REMARKS
                      AS Non_Financial_Cov_Remarks,
                   c.assessment_rc_st_index AS REPAYMENT_ST_COMMENTS,
                   REPLACE (c.assess_repay_income, CHR (10), '<br/>')
                      AS repayments_income_remarks,
                   REPLACE (c.assess_repay_interest, CHR (10), '<br/>')
                      AS repayments_rate_remarks,
                   REPLACE (c.assess_repay_bank, CHR (10), '<br/>')
                      AS repayments_bank_remarks,
                   c.group_aggregate_exposure AS group_aggregate_exposure,
                   c.group_aggregate_present AS group_aggregate_present,
                   c.group_aggregate_outstanding AS group_aggregate_outstanding,
                   c.group_aggregate_increase AS group_aggregate_increase,
                    --DECODE (
                    --  NVL (c.GROUP_PROPOSED_TOTAL, 0),
                    --  0, '-',
                    --  TO_CHAR (c.GROUP_PROPOSED_TOTAL / 1000,
                    --           '999,999,999,999,990'))
                      c.group_aggregate_exposure
					  AS IM_MEMBER_TOTAL_PROPOSED,
                   --DECODE (NVL (c.GROUP_TOTAL_INCREASE_DECREASE, 0),
                    --       0, '-',
                    --       c.GROUP_TOTAL_INCREASE_DECREASE)
                     '-' AS IM_MEMBER_TOTAL_INC_DEC,
                   c.DILIGENCE_CHECKLIST AS DILIGENCE_CHECKLIST,
                   c.NEMA_EIA_REPORT AS NEMA_EIA_REPORT,
                   c.comp_comments_index AS COMMENTS_ES,
                   c.assessment_facility_index AS ASSESSMENT_FAC_COMMENTS,
                   repay.collateral_comments AS collateral_remarks,
                   REPLACE (repay.tangible_remarks, CHR (10), '<br/>')
                      AS tangible_remarks1,
                   REPLACE (repay.intangible_remarks, CHR (10), '<br/>')
                      AS intangible_remarks1,
                   repay.assessment_facilities
                      AS assesment_of_faciliy_remarks,
                   facdata.facility_remarks_index
                      AS new_exist_facilty_remarks_clob,
                   swot.strength AS swot_strength_clob,
                   swot.weakness AS swot_weakness_clob,
                   swot.oppurtunities AS swot_opp_clob,
                   swot.threats AS swot_threat_clob,
                   DECODE (CEIL (NVL (cdata.OMV, 0)), 0, '-', cdata.OMV)
                      AS SecurityCvrOMV,
                   DECODE (CEIL (NVL (cdata.FSV, 0)), 0, '-', cdata.FSV)
                      AS SecurityCvrFSV,
                   DECODE (
                      NVL (cdata.total_charge, 0),
                      0, '-',
                      TO_CHAR ( (cdata.total_charge / 1000),
                               '999,999,999,999,990'))
                      AS Total_Charge,
                   DECODE (
                      CEIL (NVL (ROUND ( (cdata.value_fsv / 1000), 1), 0)),
                      0, '-',
                      TO_CHAR (ROUND ( (cdata.value_fsv / 1000), 1),
                               '999,999,999,999,990.0'))
                      AS FSV,
                   DECODE (
                      CEIL (NVL (ROUND ( (cdata.value_omv / 1000), 1), 0)),
                      0, '-',
                      TO_CHAR (ROUND ( (cdata.value_omv / 1000), 1),
                               '999,999,999,999,990.0'))
                      AS OMV,
                   eaudit.remarks_index AS eauditcomments,
                   iaudit.remarks_index AS iauditcomments,
                   REPLACE (wc.working_capital, CHR (10), '<br/>')
                      AS working_capital,
                   REPLACE (fa.fixed_asset_index, CHR (10), '<br/>')
                      AS finanacial_net_assets,
                   REPLACE (nw.net_worth, CHR (10), '<br/>')
                      AS financial_net_growth,
                   REPLACE (cf.cash_flow_index, CHR (10), '<br/>')
                      AS financial_cash_flow,
                   (SELECT core_capital_amount
                      FROM RW_clos_core_capital_amount
                     WHERE description = 'I bank core capital')
                      AS core_capital_amount,
                   /*(SELECT NVL (aggergate_conc_limit, 0)
                      FROM rw_clos_conc_limits_txn
                     WHERE description =
                              'Single Obligor/ Group exposure limit- Aggregate exposure to any one person (net of provisions for NPA accounts). This policy does not apply to i) lending to public entities ii) transactions with other banks iii) Purchase of or advances made against clean or documentary bills of exchange or documents of title to goods entitling some person to payment outside Kenya for imports.'
                           AND workitem_name = customer.workitem_name)
                      AS aggergate_conc_limit,*/
                   c.COMP_COMMENTS AS COMPLIANCE_COMMENTS,
				   facdata.COMMENTS_ON_FACILITY as facility_Comments_Clob,
				   repo.FIRST_SOURCE_INDEX as FIRST_SOURCE_INDEX,

  repo.SECOND_SOURCE_INDEX as SECOND_SOURCE_INDEX,

  repo.THIRD_SOURCE_INDEX as THIRD_SOURCE_INDEX,

  repo.FOURTH_SOURCE_INDEX as FOURTH_SOURCE_INDEX,


  dechist.PREPARED_BY_USERNAME,
           dechist.PREPARED_BY_DESIGNATION,
           dechist.PREPARED_BY_ENTRY_DATE_TIME,
           dechist.RECOMMENDED_BY_USERNAME,
		   dechist.RECOMMENDED_BY_DESIGNATION,
		   dechist.RECOMMENDED_BY_ENTRY_DATE_TIME,
		   dechist.APPROVED_BY_USERNAME,
		   dechist.APPROVED_BY_DESIGNATION,
		   dechist.APPROVED_BY_ENTRY_DATE_TIME,

		condet.PHONE as PHONE,
		   condet.EMAIL as EMAIL,
		   condet.CONTACT_PERSON as CONTACT_PERSON,
		   addet.PO_BOX as PO_BOX,
		   addet.PHYSICAL_ADDRESS as PHYSICAL_ADDRESS,
		   customer.PUBLICLY_LISTED as PUBLICLY_LISTED,
		   customer.POLITICALLY_EXPOSED as POLITICALLY_EXPOSED,
		   customer.MARKET_CAPITALISATION as MARKET_CAPITALISATION,
		  decision.PREVIOUS_RISK_RATING as PREVIOUS_RISK_RATING,
			customer.CREDIT_REQUEST as CREDIT_REQUEST,
      (select x.COMPANY_TYPE FROM RW_CLOS_COLLATERAL_INSURANCE_DETAILS x full join  RW_CLOS_COLLATERAL_DETAILS y on x.CHILD_MAPPING= y.PARENT_MAPPING WHERE y.workitem_name=ext.workitem_name ) as "INSURANCE_COMPANY",
 z.COMMENTS as "BACKGROUND_OF_BUSINESS",
 zz.CASH_FLOW as Repayment_Capacity,
 
			(select insider.IS_IM_BANK_PARTY_INSIDER from RW_CLOS_SHAREHOLDING_DIRECTOR_GUARANTOR_DETAILS where STAKEHOLDER_TYPE='Director' order by insider.workitem_name desc FETCH first 1 ROWS ONLY) as IS_IM_BANK_PARTY_INSIDER


			 FROM rw_clos_customer_info customer

			 LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_decision_remarks decision
                      ON customer.workitem_name = decision.workitem_name
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_ext ext
                      ON customer.workitem_name = ext.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_ext_risk_rating risk
                      ON customer.workitem_name = risk.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_client_overview client
                      ON customer.workitem_name = client.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_client_details client_details
                      ON customer.workitem_name =
                            client_details.workitem_name
                            
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN RW_CLOS_FINANCIALS_CASH_FLOW zz on zz.workitem_name=ext.workitem_name        
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_financials_pl sales
                      ON customer.workitem_name = sales.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_comments c
                      ON customer.workitem_name = c.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_repayment_terms repay
                      ON customer.workitem_name = repay.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_swot_analysis swot
                      ON customer.workitem_name = swot.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_financials_working wc
                      ON customer.workitem_name = wc.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_financials_fixed_asset fa
                      ON customer.workitem_name = fa.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_financials_net_worth nw
                      ON customer.workitem_name = nw.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_financials_cash_flow cf
                      ON customer.workitem_name = cf.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN RW_CLOS_COLLATERAL_DATA cdata
                      ON customer.workitem_name = cdata.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_external_audit eaudit
                      ON customer.workitem_name = eaudit.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_internal_audit iaudit
                      ON customer.workitem_name = iaudit.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN RW_CLOS_ENV_SOCIAL_LIST env
                      ON customer.workitem_name = env.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_facility_data facdata
                      ON customer.workitem_name = facdata.workitem_name
				   LEFT OUTER JOIN RW_CLOS_REPAYMENT_SOURCE repo
                      ON customer.workitem_name = repo.workitem_name
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN rw_clos_summary_concession concsumm
                      ON customer.workitem_name = concsumm.workitem_name 
                      LEFT OUTER JOIN RW_CLOS_REPAYMENT_SOURCE sor
                      ON customer.workitem_name = sor.workitem_name

					   LEFT OUTER JOIN RW_CLOS_DECISION_HISTORY hist
                      ON customer.workitem_name = hist.workitem_name

					   LEFT OUTER JOIN RW_CLOS_CONTACT_DETAIL condet
                      ON customer.workitem_name = condet.workitem_name
					   LEFT OUTER JOIN RW_CLOS_ADDRESS_DETAIL addet
                      ON customer.workitem_name = addet.workitem_name

					  LEFT OUTER JOIN RW_CLOS_SHAREHOLDING_DIRECTOR_GUARANTOR_DETAILS insider
                      ON customer.workitem_name = insider.workitem_name
               left outer join RW_CLOS_CLIENT_OVERVIEW z on z.workitem_name=ext.workitem_name       

					  LEFT OUTER JOIN DECHISTORY_VW dechist
                      ON customer.workitem_name = dechist.workitem_name

                      -- LEFT OUTER JOIN clos_social_category soc
                              -- ON customer.workitem_name = soc.workitem_name
           ) s1
           LEFT OUTER JOIN (  SELECT (NVL (SUM (proposed_limit_kes), 0))
                                        AS im_member_total_limit,
                                     (NVL (SUM (outstanding_balance_kes), 0))
                                        AS im_member_total_outstanding,
                                     workitem_name AS wi
                                FROM rw_clos_borrowing
                               WHERE BORROWING_MEMBER = 'Yes'
                            GROUP BY workitem_name) s2
              ON s1.workitem_name = s2.wi
           LEFT OUTER JOIN (  SELECT workitem_name AS wn,
                                     SUM (shareholder_percent)
                                        AS total_sharsholdings
                                FROM rw_clos_shareholder_name
                            GROUP BY workitem_name) s3
              ON s1.workitem_name = s3.wn
           LEFT OUTER JOIN (  SELECT workitem_name AS wni,
                                     TO_CHAR (SUM (total_nonfunded),
                                              '999,999,999,999,990')
                                        AS total_nonfunded,
                                     TO_CHAR (SUM (total_funded),
                                              '999,999,999,999,990')
                                        AS total_funded
                                FROM (  SELECT TO_CHAR (SUM (proposed_limit_kes))
                                                  AS total_funded,
                                               '' AS total_nonfunded,
                                               workitem_name
                                          FROM RW_clos_new_existing_facilities
                                         WHERE facility_type IN
                                                  ('Bills Discounting',
                                                   'Term Loan',
                                                   'Overdraft',
                                                   'Temporary Overdraft',
                                                   'Asset Finance',
                                                   'Hire Purchase',
                                                   'Insurance Premium Finance',
                                                   'Lease Finance',
                                                   'Short Term Loan')
                                      GROUP BY workitem_name
                                      UNION ALL
                                        SELECT '' AS total_funded,
                                               TO_CHAR (SUM (proposed_limit_kes))
                                                  AS total_nonfunded,
                                               workitem_name
                                          FROM RW_clos_new_existing_facilities
                                         WHERE facility_type NOT IN
                                                  ('Bills Discounting',
                                                   'Term Loan',
                                                   'Overdraft',
                                                   'Temporary Overdraft',
                                                   'Asset Finance',
                                                   'Hire Purchase',
                                                   'Insurance Premium Finance',
                                                   'Lease Finance',
                                                   'Short Term Loan')
                                      GROUP BY workitem_name) a
                            GROUP BY workitem_name) s4

              ON s1.workitem_name = s4.wni );
